scenarios.title: Visitor navigates to the root URL
scenarios.when: a visitor requests the base root path
then: the visitor receives a successful HTML landing page instead of a not found error
the page does not display the previous not found message stating 'Nothing to see here'
the page presents documentation introducing the available API endpoints

scenarios.title: Root landing page lists and documents available API endpoints
given: a visitor is viewing the base root HTML landing page
scenarios.when: the visitor reads the documented API endpoints
then: documentation for creating an event (e.g. /new/:event) is displayed
documentation for scanning an item code (e.g. /:id/:code) is displayed
documentation for viewing reports (e.g. /report/:secret) is displayed
documentation for generating random codes (e.g. /random/:secret) is displayed
documentation for generating PDF documents (e.g. /pdf/:secret) is displayed
documentation for expiration handling (e.g. /expire) is displayed

scenarios.title: Visitor requests an undefined route
scenarios.when: a visitor requests an unrecognized path (e.g. /nonexistent)
then: the visitor receives a not found error indication
the API documentation landing page is not displayed

scenarios.title: Visitor requests the root URL with query parameters
scenarios.when: a visitor requests the base root path with query parameters (e.g. /?format=html)
then: the visitor receives the successful HTML landing page documenting the available API endpoints
